home.title: Your voice matters.
home.lead: Seen a problem or incident affecting your community? Tell HTP Khabar directly.
home.step1: even without your name. You get a report number right away.
home.step2: HTP Khabar journalists verify the facts.
home.notice: Sending a report does not guarantee publication. Your exact location and contact details are never made public.
home.demo: Demo version — please don't send real reports.

done.next2: If we need more, we'll ask through this link.
